cua-driver.description: Control the X11 desktop: take screenshots, inspect windows, and send mouse and keyboard actions.

playwright.description: Automate web pages in the container's shared Chromium browser.
args: p=$(basename "$(readlink "$CHROMIUM_USER_DATA_DIR/SingletonLock" 2>/dev/null)" | awk -F- '{print $NF}'); running=false; case "$p" in ''|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) exe=$(readlink "/proc/$p/exe" 2>/dev/null); case "${exe##*/}" in chromium|chromium-browser|chrome) running=true ;; esac ;; esac; if [ "$running" != true ] || ! timeout -k 2s 15s npx -y @playwright/cli -s=shared tab-list --json >/dev/null 2>&1; then timeout -k 5s 60s npx -y @playwright/cli open -s=shared --profile "$CHROMIUM_USER_DATA_DIR" --headed >&2 || exit $?; fi; exec npx -y @playwright/mcp --endpoint shared
